(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices

අති විෙශෂ
No. 1924/50 – FRIDAY, JULY 24, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT) ACT, NO. 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: Thiprale 1/8/3/44/Ath.
Land Ministry No. : 4-3/3/2013/HA/601.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the Land or servitude to acquired: Acquisition of the servitude of the Access Road to the New District secretariat.

Allotment of land in extent about 0.1371 Hectares shown as Lot Nos. 1-4 in the Advance tracing No. P.P.Co.9554 and dated 19.06.2015 prepared by the surveyor General, Situated at Kirula Grama Niladhary Division at Narahenpita Village within the limits of Colombo Municipal Council in the Divisional Secretariat Division of Thimbrigasyaya, Colombo District, Western Province. Distribution the above lands are as follows:
Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Samagi Wattha (Sir Oliver Gunathilaka Park); Present Land Use: Road; Climants Name and Address: Not Known; Extent: 0.1271 Hectare.
Lot No. 02 Name of the Land: Samagi Wattha (Sir Oliver Gunathilaka Park); Present Land Use: Road; Climants Name and Address: State; Extent: 0.0004 Hectare.
Lot No. 03 Name of the Land: Samagi Wattha (Sir Oliver Gunathilaka Park); Present Land Use: Road; Climants Name and Address: State; Extent: 0.0015 Hectare.
Lot No. 04 Name of the Land: Samagi Wattha (Sir Oliver Gunathilaka Park); Present Land Use: Road; Climants Name and Address: State; Extent: 0.0081 Hectare.

Total: Extent: 0.1371 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired* are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at Thimbirigasyaya Divisional Secretariat on the 30th day of October, 2015 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 26th day of October, 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude*, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
GEETAMANI C. KARUNARATHNA, Divisional Secretary, Thimbrigasyaya. Divisional Secretariat, Thimbrigasyaya, 22nd July, 2015. 08 - 241
